provider_name_claim.invariant: One normalized provider name is uniquely reserved within a tenant.
provider_name_claim.implementation: ProviderNameClaim checks the claim stream realm and area, then delegates Claim and Release plus replay to shared NameClaim. Unlike LocationNameClaim, it has no feature-specific validation that holder is a provider stream in the same tenant.

control_criterion_mapping.invariant: One program, control, edition, criterion tuple has an independently revised proposal line with an immutable approved successor.
control_criterion_mapping.implementation: ControlCriterionMapping identity is a typed hash of tenant, program, control, edition, criterion. It uses MappingLineTransitions for proposal/review/retirement and sequence checks; historical composition is delegated to a reader.

program_readiness.invariant: One tenant/program readiness governor retains a compact latest assessment pointer, serializes latest-assessment adoption with decision append, holds one pending adoption generation, and retains latest management and permanent approved Type I entry decisions.
program_readiness.implementation: ProgramReadiness has one tenant/program stream, run and decision admission checks, pending run/decision state, adoption generation, accepted and terminal decision pointers, and reducers for readiness and Type I entry events.

provider_name_claim_holder.instructions: Does the tenant-scoped provider-name uniqueness invariant require ProviderNameClaim to accept and replay claims only when the holder is a provider stream in the same tenant?

criteria.true: A claim or replay naming a foreign-tenant or non-provider stream violates the provider-name claim owner rule.
criteria.false: The selected invariant only constrains the claim stream and does not constrain the holder stream identity.

control_criterion_mapping_boundary.instructions: Does the stated tuple identity and independently revised mapping lifecycle support keeping each control-criterion mapping line as its own aggregate?

criteria.true: Each tuple has its own proposal, review, and retirement history, so the line can be revised independently.
criteria.false: The rule requires multiple mapping tuples to be decided atomically as one owner.

program_readiness_boundary.instructions: Does the readiness lifecycle described here justify one tenant/program governor that serializes adoption and decision admission while keeping full assessment content outside that stream?

criteria.true: The current/latest pointer and pending-generation rules require serialized program-level decisions, while full content can remain elsewhere.
criteria.false: There is no shared program-level decision to serialize, or full assessment content must be owned inside the readiness stream.
